A software project manager is a person who undertakes the responsibility of executing the software project.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a chart derived from Data Flow Diagram."

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a critical element of software development life cycles called software quality control or software quality assurance."
Testing is a critical element of software development life cycles called software quality control or software quality assurance.
